params.name: collectionId
params.description: Key/id of the collection for which item should be filtered and returned.

params.name: exampleAggregationName
params.description: This is an EXAMPLE aggregation expression. More aggregation expressions can be specified by adding additional query parameters, where the name of the parameter is an arbitrary alphabetic aggregation name

params.name: filter
params.description: CQL filter expression that can be used to refine the aggregation search

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of results returned for "bucket"-based aggregations

params.name: token
params.description: Token to use when accessing the underlying ArcGIS Item that represents the site.

items.docs: Returns requested aggregations from the specified site catalog collection
